description: Flat metadata schema for individual bacterial single amplified genomes (SAGs) generated from soil samples using whole genome amplification and next-generation sequencing.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual SAG record within the dataset; use a stable accession or internally assigned ID.

sample_id.descr: Identifier of the original soil sample from which this SAG was generated.

collection_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected (ISO 8601 format, YYYY-MM-DD).

collection_time.descr: Time of sample collection, if available (local time or ISO 8601 time).

collector.descr: Name, initials, or organization responsible for sample collection.

country.descr: Country where the soil sample was collected.

region.descr: Administrative region, state, province, or similar location descriptor for the collection site.

locality.descr: Nearest city, site name, or locality description of the collection site.

site_description.descr: Free-text description of the collection site, including habitat context and any notable features.

latitude.descr: Latitude of the collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Longitude of the collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

elevation_m.descr: Elevation of the collection site in meters above sea level.

ecosystem_type.descr: Broad ecosystem category; for example forest, grassland, agricultural soil, desert, wetland, tundra, or urban soil.

soil_type.descr: Soil classification or textural class; for example loam, clay, sandy loam, peat, or a formal soil taxonomy if available.

soil_pH.descr: Soil pH measured at collection or from a paired analysis.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent wet weight or gravimetric water content, if measured.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at the time of collection in degrees Celsius.

ambient_temperature_c.descr: Air or ambient temperature at the time of sampling in degrees Celsius.

precipitation_condition.descr: Qualitative description of precipitation or moisture conditions during sampling; for example dry, wet, after rainfall, or irrigated.

organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content in percent, if measured.

nutrient_status.descr: Qualitative or classified description of nutrient availability; for example low, moderate, high, or fertilized.

land_use.descr: Land use category at the collection site; for example native, agricultural, pasture, forest-managed, or urban.

vegetation_type.descr: Dominant vegetation or plant community associated with the soil site.

depth_cm.descr: Soil sampling depth in centimeters below the surface; use a single value or representative depth for the record.

sample_matrix.descr: Material sampled; for this dataset typically soil, but may include rhizosphere soil, litter-associated soil, or sediment-like soil matrices.

storage_condition.descr: Condition used to store the sample before processing; for example chilled, frozen, or preserved in buffer.

time_to_processing_h.descr: Time between collection and initial processing in hours.

single_cell_or_genome_source.descr: Source material for amplification; for example single bacterial cell, sorted cell, or SAG-derived template.

cell_isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the individual cell or genome template prior to amplification; for example FACS, micromanipulation, or dilution to extinction.

whole_genome_amplification_kit.descr: Name of the whole genome amplification kit or reagent system used; for example REPLI-g, MALBAC, or MDA-based kit.

whole_genome_amplification_protocol.descr: Brief protocol name or description for the amplification workflow, including any notable modifications.

whole_genome_amplification_input_amount_.descr: Input DNA amount for whole genome amplification in nanograms, if applicable.

whole_genome_amplification_reaction_volu.descr: Reaction volume for whole genome amplification in microliters, if applicable.

wga_cycles.descr: Number of amplification cycles or incubation/amplification duration indicator, if relevant to the protocol.

library_prep_kit.descr: Library preparation kit used before sequencing, if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used; for example Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, PacBio Sequel, or Oxford Nanopore MinION.

sequencing_technology.descr: Sequencing chemistry or technology class; for example short-read, long-read, paired-end, or single-end.

read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for the sequencing run, if applicable.

paired_end.descr: Whether the sequencing data are paired-end reads.

insert_size_bp.descr: Approximate library insert size in base pairs, if available.

sequencing_center.descr: Facility or institution where sequencing was performed.

sequencing_date.descr: Date of sequencing run or library submission, if available.

raw_reads_count.descr: Total number of raw sequencing reads generated for this SAG.

raw_bases_gb.descr: Total raw bases generated for this SAG in gigabases.

assembly_software.descr: Name of the genome assembly software used; for example SPAdes, MEGAHIT, or Flye.

assembly_version.descr: Version of the assembly software used.

assembly_parameters.descr: Key assembly parameters or command-line options used, recorded as free text.

assembly_date.descr: Date the assembly was performed, if available.

contig_count.descr: Number of contigs in the final assembly.

assembly_length_bp.descr: Total assembled genome length in base pairs.

n50_bp.descr: Assembly N50 value in base pairs.

largest_contig_bp.descr: Length of the largest contig in base pairs.

gc_content_percent.descr: GC content of the assembled genome in percent.

genome_completeness_percent.descr: Estimated genome completeness in percent, if assessed.

genome_contamination_percent.descr: Estimated genome contamination or redundancy in percent, if assessed.

binning_used.descr: Whether genome binning was applied during reconstruction.

binning_software.descr: Name of binning software used, if applicable.

taxonomic_assignment.descr: Best available taxonomic identification for the SAG; for example genus, species, or higher-level classification.

taxonomic_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic assignment; for example marker gene analysis, GTDB-Tk, or BLAST-based classification.

functional_potential_focus.descr: Primary ecological or functional theme inferred for the genome; for example nutrient cycling, carbon degradation, nitrogen cycling, sulfur cycling, or phosphorus cycling.

nutrient_cycling_role.descr: Specific nutrient cycling role inferred or targeted, such as nitrification, denitrification, ammonification, phosphorus mobilization, or sulfur oxidation.

project_name.descr: Name of the project or study associated with the SAG record.

principal_investigator.descr: Principal investigator or lead researcher responsible for the study.

institution.descr: Institution responsible for the sample or data generation.

data_repository_accession.descr: Accession or identifier in a public repository such as NCBI SRA, GenBank, ENA, or IMG.

assembly_accession.descr: Accession for the assembled genome, if deposited in a public repository.

associated_publication.descr: Citation, DOI, or reference to a publication describing the dataset or genome.

license.descr: Data reuse license or usage terms, if specified.
